viewing_check: Look underneath and on the back for a foundry name, registration diamond or casting numbers; check weight (period iron is heavy, reproductions thinner), casting sharpness, check for hairline cracks or repairs at arm scrolls and leg joins, confirm both ends are a matching pair and photograph the seat-slat bolt holes and a measured height.
